REM Collect the process list for the nightly report.
REM tasklist /fo csv writes a header line first:
REM "Image Name","PID","Session Name","Session#","Mem Usage"
REM and one quoted row per process after it, such as
REM "notepad.exe","4242","Console","1","12,345 K"
tasklist /fo csv > "%TEMP%\processes.csv"
